summary: The Backrooms is a persistent multiplayer survival RPG spanning an authored Level 0 maze, deeper lore-based destinations, a social mall and solo tutorial spaces. `templates/player.js` composes shared player behavior; `scripts/player.js` owns player progression and combat, while place simulations and shared libraries build/tick environments, NPCs, quests and crossings.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0/Lobby maze; sim lays ecology, generated moments, safe rooms and routes to its exits.
places/bonus (3D) - vaporwave mall with authored shops, escalators and simulated staff/shoppers; shared hub destination.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo ephemeral) - character creation/waking and staged tutorial route.
places/level01 (3D) - Zenith Station: station, breach, doors, bots, hazards and recorder quest.
places/level1, level2, level21, level3, gamma (3D) - Habitable Zone/M.E.G. camp, Pipe Dreams, Locked, Electrical Station and Base Gamma.
places/level4, level5, level6, level7, level8 (3D) - Abandoned Office, Terror Hotel, drowned house, sea/Fort Surrender and Cave Systems.
places/level10, level11, level12 (3D) - lake, generated city/canal and renovation office; Level 11 connects to player home11.
places/level26, level27, level184, level61, spamton, testlab and other special places (3D) - SS Fun, Bunker Springs, forts, Snackrooms, arena and Test Range.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, camera/player setup, ordered behaviors and input mappings.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local place config, authored placements and generated/ticked simulation.
scripts/main-menu.js + main-menu-ui.js + intake/tutorial scripts - title, creation, arrival and tutorial routing.
scripts/player.js + scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js - player state/actions, aiming camera and third-person toggle.
places/main/sim.js + scripts/lib/level0-moments.js - Level 0 maze simulation and seeded environmental moments.
places/level1/sim.js + scripts/lib/level1.js - seeded ground/deck layout, camp, doors and threshold dressing.
scripts/lib/quests.js + quest-marker.js + quest-mark.js + quest-route.js - quest state, objective resolution and local/remote markers.
places/bonus/cells/x0z0.scene + places/testlab/sim.js - authored mall/escalator and generated Test Range facilities.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js - solo room IDs, Bonus Room/home destinations and LEVEL_NAMES used by hub UI.
scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js + scripts/lib/weapons.js/scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml - common loot, containers, item definitions, rarity and weapon variants.
scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js - parametric door geometry and hinge motion reused by doors.
scripts/lib/thresholds.js + scripts/threshold-geo.js - versioned crossing clues shared by participating place simulations.
scripts/lib/quest-route.js + scripts/lib/quest-mark.js - crossing graph and objective resolver for tracked quests.
scripts/lib/level11-vaults.js + level11-depths.js + l11-crawl-geo.js - Level 11 vault, crawl geometry and place systems.
scripts/lib/build-piece.js + scripts/lib/data/breakables.yml + scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml - shared build, harvest, breakable and reconstruction specs.
scripts/lib/critter-model.js + cat-wardrobe.js + wardrobe/clothes data + appearance materials - player/NPC human, furry and Tripo cat paths.
notableExports: scripts/lib/thresholds.js - dressThresholds; scripts/threshold-geo.js - threshold geometry/material builders.
scripts/lib/quest-route.js - nextQuestExit; scripts/lib/quest-mark.js - questMark; scripts/lib/quests.js - MAX_TRACK, TINT, PLACE_NAMES, qid, setQuest, endQuest, tracked, toggleTrack.

scripts/lib/loot.js - POOL, poolOf, rollWeapon, gateItems, rollLock, rollCash, rollItem, spawnCrate and Level 2 helpers; scripts/lib/weapons.js - baseOf, variantOf, rollVariant, rarityIdx, rarityCap, default.
scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, gain, takeToken, useSnack, onInput, hitTarget, fish callbacks, HOLO/holoEnd and throwable callbacks.

scripts/lib/critter-model.js - setStyle, HUMAN, STYLE_V, cat and human appearance builders, restylePlace/Queue/Step; scripts/lib/cat-wardrobe.js - CAT_BODY, CAT_OLD, CAT_BODY2 and cat appearance builders.
scripts/lib/body3.js - heldRot, famOf, play, tick3, swing3, fire3, handle3, react3, stagger3, aimPose, aimMode, longHands, stance; scripts/lib/vmpose.js - VM_FOV, poseViewmodel.
places/level1/sim.js - cadence, agentSpec, tick; places/level5/sim.js - cadence, lay.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment, needs, combat, access, appearance, saved position and carried tapes.
scripts/lib/quests.js - player.state.quests, qtrack and qdone; quest handlers own quest-specific state; dina-quest.js owns dinaQ, dinaDiary, dcut and seeds the-way-back.
scripts/kick.js + scripts/grab.js - kick cooldowns and carry/held target session; held objects own heldBy/down/stagger state.
scripts/lib/loose.js + breakables.js - loose prop state and wrecks; permanently smashed root IDs live in place.state.gone.
scripts/lib/knock.js + stats.js - foe weight/attributes and down/stagger outcomes; enemy managers own AI and sneakTarget.
Place sims - local generated scene and migration markers, including Level 1 back-door rebuild and Level 4 office/island conversions.
scripts/lib/prop-interactions.js + scripts/prop-part.js - prop open/lamp state and child part animation goals.
scripts/lib/thresholds.js - place.state.thrSeen/thrTry/thrDone/thrV placement protocol; testlab sim owns its lootPool/labV and consumes pad requests.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered locomotion, player/foe, swim/climb, interact, grab/kick, build, inventory, combat, social, hub, camera and quest behaviors.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera; camera writes aimPt/aimPitch → player.js ballistics.
scripts/routing.js requested room → scripts/lib/hub.js solo room selection; toHub/toSolo cross to hub/home and maintain roomHop/save-place state.
Fresh visit → main-menu.js; START routes to intake or Bonus, wardrobe close to intro/tutorial0; menuOpen drives menu UI and solo pause scales place time.
Hub destinations → hub-ui.js/hub.js crossings; Bonus sim lays NPCs/effects and mall handlers consume shop/food state; escalator steps use esc-step.js.
interact.js loot search → loot.gateItems → items/weapons roll; rarity caps are 1-2 common, 3-5 uncommon, 6-9 rare, 10+ elite.
interact.js focus → player.state.focus → loot-ui prompt; talk UI emits talk/talkdo/shop actions; screen/theme hide prompts behind panels.
interact open/closeLoot → prop-interactions.containerPose → child part state.goal → prop-part.js animation; toggleLamp changes light-part goals.
Player craft action/UI → craft.js + craft.yml; breakables/build pieces define station; craft UI filters station recipes while hand menu lists all.
Tracked quest → quest-marker.js → questMark/nextQuestExit gated crossing graph → local objective or remote exit marker and journal.

Place sims → dressThresholds → threshold-geo dressing; door/use triggers call carryAcross before ctx.cross, bringing held props/creatures (not into Bonus/room links) and recording xferTo for an arrival marker; player.js consumes xferTo to land on it.
critter-model restylePlace → gathers wardrobe-parent IDs once per pass → restyle bodies; sims call restyle queue/step so human/furry changes cover NPCs without per-body full-object rescans.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus scenes + bonus data/sim + mall shopper/salon scripts - authored mall, NPCs and counter behavior; escalator steps share motor behavior with placement-specific direction/phase.
scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction scripts - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild flow.
scripts/door-geo.js + door-swing.js and prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametrically generated doors/storage parts with eased motion and legacy prop migration.
scripts/lib/thresholds.js + threshold-geo.js + participating place sims - threshold dressing varies by destination, clue kind and inward direction.
places/level01/sim.js + zenith geometry, breach, hatch, bot and hazard scripts - Zenith Station environment and interactive systems.
places/level4 scenes/sim + l4-office, l4-office-geo, l4-home and resident data - office/hotel fixtures and attached residents.
scripts/lib/critter-model.js + cat wardrobe/clothes data + material and art builders - reusable human/furry/Tripo cat rigs with varied looks and fitted attachments.
places/level7/sim.js + art/fort-gate/build.py + Fort Surrender GLB - open palisade gateway and separate solid wall blocks, with ramp/floor placement fitted to the gate.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists, while Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is the documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js, scripts/debug-pad.js, scripts/lib/debug-layout.js - debug-room pads/layout after places/debug removal; no current references found.
migrationNotes: Threshold dressing version is now V=7 in scripts/lib/thresholds.js; upgrades clean/rebuild thr-tagged objects and remain delayed/incremental until place colliders stand. Preserve thrSeen/thrTry/thrDone/thrV protocol.

carryAcross records xferTo only for local place links with a # marker; it crosses carryId and nearby heldBy objects, but rejects room/world and Bonus destinations. Keep it immediately before ctx.cross at doorway handlers.
Level 1 BACK moved well away from camp: sim's backV rebuild destroys and respawns the door, lamp, wall and arrival because moving a static trigger's transform leaves its collider behind.

critter-model STYLE_V is sw185; restylePlace builds a wardrobe-parent set once and passes it to each restyle call. Avoid reinstating per-NPC full object-key scans; parented bodies still need detection.
Cat appearance path requires !HUMAN, MESH and speciesOf(look)==='cat'; human/other furry paths stay separate. Cat body shape keys must continue through fitted hair/fluff and clothes.
Fort Surrender gateway uses a cut/open gate asset while its remaining shell walls are independently solid; the ramp must meet the fort floor flush and remain walkable.
